decisions.reason: Its move from a simple mention to a dedicated webpage suggests improving commercial traction, and as a close extension of the core heat-exchanger business it is inexpensive to keep while demand continues to develop.

Like B, it gained a standalone presentation on the website, which indicates commitment and positive early resolution of uncertainty in a growing market closely aligned with the firm's established capabilities.

This tube-liner repair offering fits the firm's lifecycle-service model and likely has low carrying cost, so even modest uncertainty still favors retention despite weaker evidence of scaling than for B and C.

A customized air-cooler line with several models supports the firm's integrated-solution strategy and broad industrial customer base, making it a reasonable option to preserve while market uptake matures.

These repair inserts build directly on installed-base service business and should be relatively cheap to maintain in the portfolio, so the option value of serving maintenance needs outweighs the case for dropping them now.
